title: The Courtyard Ritual
subtitle: Seochon’s quiet ritual of water and stone.
line: A sanctuary of serenity where the ancient rhythm of a courtyard ritual meets contemporary skincare.
synopsis: As you step into the store, the bustling streets of Seochon fade away, replaced by the profound stillness of an open-air Hanok courtyard. Your journey begins at a central black stone basin, an invitation to a meditative cleansing ritual. You then drift towards the warm, earthy strata-clay walls, where Aesop products are nestled like hidden treasures. The journey concludes at a serene wooden counter at the rear of the space.

why.d: Shelf walls (shelving embedded in stone walls) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room. These grounded, earth-toned shelves anchor the space in the aesthetic of traditional Korean architecture.

The centre object (meditative stone basin ritual) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. This central basin forces a purposeful pause, centering the visitor in the present moment through the element of water.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. By drawing the visitor around the central basin, the design ensures the experience is contemplative and flow-driven.
The counter (minimalist payment counter) sits at the back, off the loop. The wooden counter provides a warm, tactile conclusion to the ritualistic experience.

materials.name: Raw Terracotta Strata
materials.where: floor, shelving embedded in stone walls
